peakProxy: Use the minimum across frames and green parities of the peak above the background divided by the robust annular background scale from the exact source fit.
centroid: Average of the two green centers from the frozen IC1805 report.
comparison: Fit all models on identical training points for each exposure, with identical evaluation points. Clip squared proxy divided by squared training median to [0.25,4]. Retain all 38 exposures and report marginal pooled and per-frame P90. Reused stars and common reference prevent independent exposure-level inference.
